new.dependsNone: Must not depend on any other layer.

verify.noGuardrails: AGENTS.md does not contain a '## Guardrails' section
verify.ok: Layer '{layer}' is fine (structure and instruction links).
test.layerMissing: Error: layer '{layer}' does not exist in src/.
test.notActive: Error: '{layer}' is not an active layer. Retired layers (prefix '_retired-') are not tested.
test.noRunner: Layer '{layer}' has no test runner ({runner}). Skipping.
delete.notActive: Error: layer '{layer}' is not active in src/.
delete.planFooter: Nothing changed. Run with --yes to apply (the folder content is kept).
delete.footer: The layer is no longer active. Do the hard delete (remove the folder) manually if you do not want to archive it.
rename.argsMissing: Error: missing layer name or the new name. Usage: {usage}
rename.notActive: Error: layer '{layer}' is not active in src/.
rename.planFooter: Nothing changed. Run with --yes to apply.
rename.footer: Check `src/AGENTS.md` and `docs/layers.md` that the new name also fits manual edits.
map.notActive: Layer '{layer}' is not active in src/.
map.invalidName: Invalid layer name '{name}'. Use PascalCase letters and digits.
map.sameName: The new layer is the same as the original ('{name}').
map.delete.planCleanup: Clean mentions:   {files} and the AGENTS.md of other layers
map.rename.planMentions: Rewrite mentions: all project files (name, slug and title)
map.retired.noteIntro: This layer was retired by the `delete-layer` script (soft retire).
map.retired.noteKept: The folder content is intentionally kept, but the layer is no longer part of the live map:
map.retired.noteBullet1: - it starts with the `_retired-` prefix, so sync, verify and CI do not treat it as active,
map.retired.noteBullet2: - it was removed from `.scaffold.json` and from references in the instructions.
map.retired.noteHard: If you really want to delete it, remove this whole folder manually (hard delete).
map.dependsNone: Must not depend on any other layer.
sync.notInSync: Agent configuration is NOT in sync with the sources in the layers.
